daily.today_energy: Venus is hanging out in your sign today, which feels like a natural win for you. With Mars conjunct Jupiter firing up though, there's this restless competitive energy in the air that might make your usual diplomatic vibe feel a bit tested.
daily.love: Your ruling planet Venus is literally in your corner right now, making you magnetic and genuinely likeable. If you're single, people are noticing. If you're coupled up, lean into quality time—the vibe is there for real connection.
daily.career: Sun square Mars is creating some friction, so today might feel like you're pushing against something. Don't overthink it—use that tension productively. Your balanced perspective is actually your superpower when things get heated.
daily.health: The Pisces Moon wants you to slow down and tune inward. Even if you're tempted to match the Leo Mars energy around you, taking 20 minutes to actually rest will serve you better than pushing through.

weekly.overview: Venus is dancing through your sector of self-discovery this week, Libra. You're feeling less indecisive and more aligned with what actually matters to you. Trust the subtle shifts happening behind the scenes—your energy is recalibrating.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is the week to have that real conversation you've been sitting on. Single? Someone intriguing might pop up, but the real magic is learning to be genuinely present with yourself first. That's the vibe.
weekly.career: Your creative problem-solving skills are peaked right now. Channel that balanced Libra brain into projects that need fresh perspective. Don't play small—your ideas have weight this week. Let yourself be heard.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness, not grinding. Movement that feels intuitive (think yoga, long walks, dancing) will hit different than your usual routine. Sleep matters more than usual; prioritize rest as part of your self-care practice.
